scope: Pure boolean story/object flags, appear/disappear conditions, deferred landmark deletion state, NPC visibility output gates, openable door flag-update outputs, and fresh-opening body enablement. Not complete scripts, event scheduling, collision, camera or opening gameplay.
semantic_review: All 178 global story flags initially false; object flags empty. Unknown read defaults false; unknown set_flag does not emit. Known writes emit if requested even for unchanged values. Object writes create keys.
FlaggableObject defaults to object_flags[currentScene.name + "/" + leaf name], not full path. Explicit is_object_flag chooses dictionary. Editor-only behavior outside runtime scope.
Appearance is (empty appear or true flag) and (empty disappear or false flag). Missing appear hides; missing disappear does not hide.

FlagLandmark queues deletion when hidden and delete_if_hidden, without setting visible false in that branch. queue_free is not cancelled by later flags; collision/tree removal waits for deletion flush.

npc visibility callback sets collisions.disabled to inverse effective tree visibility, interaction disabled also when no dialogue, and physics processing to visibility. It overwrites prior no_collision at end of ready. Complete NPC/notifier behavior not implemented.

Openable door flag update first chooses lock/unlock from key/blocked/one_way/locked, deferring collider disabled property. Registered flag then overrides only unlocked and prompt, not collider. Full door body-entered/animation/timer behavior not implemented.

Fresh house21-body enablement allows two unlocked player-door shapes disabled, other bodies enabled. Four NonPlayerStaticBody2D shapes have layer1596 and mask0, excluded from initial player mask4353 separately.
Invisible static bodies remain enabled: present bodies and DoorBlock/Entrance. Flags-based loot state changes do not disable presents.
Fresh-opening resolver rejects unknown body paths, non-opening true flags except visited_podunk, and any object flag entries; it is not a saved or post-cutscene world evaluator.
Opening Door target520,404 becomes actual actor position520,397 via Door.change_scene targetY-7. DebugStartPos456,409 is scene-debug only. House AreaRoom ready sets visited_podunk true.

Bedroom camera area center504,376 extents208,104 yields limits296,272,712,480 at viewport320x180; camera-area script enlarges each dimension to at least viewport size and applies after idle_frame. Camera not implemented by this module.
